highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.158 introduces Skia m158, with further GPU corrections and HarfBuzz updates collected after Preview 1.
highlights_body: Preview 1 preserves the managed API surface and co-ships HarfBuzzSharp 14.4.0.300. Later collected work updates native HarfBuzz to 15.0.0, adds named script constants and improves reflected hairline, text-atlas, Vulkan teardown and Graphite clipping behavior.

bullets.detail: Updates the bundled renderer to Skia m158 without changing managed wrappers or C API declarations. HarfBuzzSharp's initial 14.4.0.300 package revision distinguishes this milestone's package set; it is not itself a native HarfBuzz upgrade.

Corrects reflected square-capped hairlines and text-atlas sampler selection, defers affected Mali Vulkan device-loss cleanup for driver versions 42 through below 56, and bounds Graphite clip recording. Draws whose clips cannot fit a fresh pass are rejected and logged rather than overflowing pass structures.

bullets.lead: Additional HarfBuzz script constants after Preview 1
bullets.detail: Adds 30 named Script fields, including Jurchen, ProtoCuneiform and Seal, while retaining the existing 149 values and the struct-based parsing and conversion API. Regeneration removes only an unused internal deprecated font-face setter import, not a public managed member.

preview_summaries.v4.158.0-preview.1.26556.2: Introduced Skia m158 with the existing managed API surface. HarfBuzzSharp moved to package revision 14.4.0.300 while its native engine remained at 14.4.0.

harfbuzz_summary: Preview 1 co-ships HarfBuzzSharp 14.4.0.300 with native HarfBuzz 14.4.0 and no public API diff. Collected changes after that shipment upgrade native HarfBuzz and its package version to 15.0.0 and add 30 named Script constants; the assembly version remains 1.0.0.0.

v4.158.0-preview.1.26556.2.headline: SkiaSharp 4.158.0 Preview 1 updates the bundled renderer to Skia m158.
v4.158.0-preview.1.26556.2.body: The managed API surface is unchanged. HarfBuzzSharp packages move to revision 14.4.0.300 while the bundled HarfBuzz engine stays at 14.4.0.
